title: King Over All
story:
A young boy visited a national museum with his school.

Inside, he saw portraits of many kings and rulers.

Some were powerful in their time.

Some were famous.

Some were forgotten.

The guide explained,

“Every ruler here had authority for a season.”

“But none of them ruled forever.”

The boy looked at a large empty throne display.

He asked,

“Is there a king who rules everything?”

The guide smiled and said,

“No earthly king rules everything.”

“But there is One whose rule has no end.”

In life, we see leaders rise and fall.

Governments change.

Systems shift.

Power moves from one hand to another.

But God reigns above all.

He is King over every nation.

Every authority bows before Him.

His rule is eternal.

And His kingdom has no end.
life_lesson:
God is the eternal King over all nations and people.

Worship Him and trust His sovereign rule.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

You are the King over all the earth.

Your rule is eternal and unshakable.

Help me to trust Your authority in my life.

Teach me to worship You with reverence and joy.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you trust God’s authority over every area of your life?

How does knowing God is King change your worries?

What area do you need to surrender to His rule today?
verse:
For God is the King of all the earth.
Sing to Him a psalm of praise.
God reigns over the nations.
God is seated on His holy throne.
